name: NoxRoute
tagline: Confidential recurring WETH/USDC execution with only an aggregate residual exposed to Uniswap V3.
problem: Public recurring strategies expose direction, size, limits, cadence, and remaining budget across transactions.
noxJobs: Persistent private strategy state across epochs
Encrypted balance sufficiency and clip eligibility
Private post-settlement allocation and remaining balances
privacySavings: Authorized viewers compare viewer-authorized requested and matched volume; ordinary observers see only the aggregate public residual.
publicBoundary: Addresses and lifecycle timing are public
Only aggregate residual and aggregateMinOut are public at finalization
protocol: Official Uniswap V3 contracts on Ethereum Sepolia
trust: TEE/Nox trust, viewer ACL correctness, and contract correctness
limitations: Sepolia test pool price and liquidity are not market-quality evidence
demo: Show exactly three aggregate public decryptions.
Compare internally matched volume with the public residual.
Open the official Uniswap transaction only when V3 E2E evidence exists.
Owner decrypts output and remaining balance.
